controls.label: Shape
controls.title: The shared grid marks unavailable surface imagery over the published MPCD shape, reconstructed from VLT/SPHERE images with an ADAM shape as its starting point. This is ground-based reconstructed geometry with uneven observational constraints, not a photographic surface texture or an albedo map. Lighting uses the observed pole and an arbitrary display phase.
controls.summary: Shape made from VLT/SPHERE observations. Gray grid: no surface imagery; lighting shows the model's form.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.title: Color shows source radius minus a 149 km reference sphere. It includes the overall irregular shape and is not height above a gravitational equipotential. The original ground-based shape constrains these heights; display pixels do not increase the observational resolution. Cartographic relief and optional Sun lighting are display treatments.
controls.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
